name: renderer
body: Renderer: executes standard Go html/template layouts (no third-party engine) with pre-rendered content — body, `text` fields and each named section (rendered through its section template) passed as safe HTML; other fields as typed values (number/date formatted per `_format`, boolean, enum, list, image/link URLs) — and the registry's minimal function map (v1: `media`). Layout execute errors become file:line-qualified templates errors. Applies theme CSS, reveal.js config (navigationMode passed through from `navigation`), vertical stacks, anchors, notes.
